rows.grounds: sandhi fusion of ṣaṣṭham and evam; internal sandhi noted, token not split
past passive participle describing what has been expounded
ordinal referring to the next item in sequence

items.question: What transition marks the completion of the sixth exposition and the beginning of the seventh?
premises: The sixth topic has been declared in this manner.
A seventh topic is now presented as the next object of attention.
The listener is directly addressed and instructed to hear.
items.inference: The exposition of the sixth topic is concluded, and the teaching proceeds to the seventh.
uncertainties: The specific content of the sixth and seventh topics is not stated in this verse.
items.plain_english: Thus the sixth has been declared; now hear the seventh, O you of good vows.
